articulation-point.title: Articulation Point
articulation-point.info: A cut vertex. Hover nodes — bridges flash magenta. Remove one and the graph splits into disconnected pieces.

cascading-failure.title: Cascading Failure
cascading-failure.info: Knock out one node. Load spills to neighbors; overloaded nodes fail next. Watch the blackout wave.

degree-distribution.title: Degree Distribution
degree-distribution.info: Left: the graph. Right: its degree histogram. Toggle random (Poisson) vs scale-free (power-law) and watch the shape.

degree-graph-theory.title: Degree
degree-graph-theory.info: Degree is how many edges touch a node. Add or drop edges on the hub; the counter tracks every link.

edge-graph-theory.title: Edge
edge-graph-theory.info: An edge is a relation. Toggle directed vs undirected and weighted vs plain — meaning changes with the marks.

emergence.title: Emergence
emergence.info: Boids obey three local rules. Tune separation, alignment, cohesion — flocking appears with no leader.

error-correcting-code.title: Error-Correcting Code
error-correcting-code.info: Noise flips bits in transit. Enable parity or Hamming; the receiver detects and repairs what the channel broke.

giant-connected-component.title: Giant Component
giant-connected-component.info: Add random edges one by one. Below the threshold: islands. At percolation a giant component crystallizes.

hub-network.title: Hub
hub-network.info: Scale-free nets have hubs. Attack hubs and connectivity collapses; random failures barely dent it.

interdependent-networks.title: Interdependent Networks
interdependent-networks.info: Power feeds comms; comms steer power. Fail one node and the cascade ricochets across both layers.

modularity-network.title: Modularity
modularity-network.info: Communities denser inside than between. Slide resolution — modules merge or split as color clusters.

node-graph-theory.title: Node
node-graph-theory.info: The atomic unit of a graph. Click the void to spawn nodes; drag links between them. Tree, neuron, router — same abstraction.

percolation-theory.title: Percolation Theory
percolation-theory.info: Occupy grid sites at probability p. Raise p until a connected path spans the lattice — the percolating cluster.

percolation-threshold.title: Percolation Threshold
percolation-threshold.info: Fine-tune p around pc. The order parameter (spanning fraction) jumps at the knife-edge critical point.

phase-transition.title: Phase Transition
phase-transition.info: Drag the control past critical. Order snaps — disordered lattice reorganizes into a coherent phase.

queue.title: Queue
queue.info: FIFO buffer. Raise arrival above service and length grows without bound. Little: L = λW.

redundancy.title: Redundancy
redundancy.info: Parallel backup paths. Sever them one by one — the system holds until the last path dies.

redundancy-engineering.title: N-Modular Redundancy
redundancy-engineering.info: Triple modular redundancy. Inject faults; the majority voter masks them until too many modules lie.

scale-free-network.title: Scale-Free Network
scale-free-network.info: Preferential attachment: new nodes link to popular hubs. Grow the net and the power-law degree tail appears.

stigmergy.title: Stigmergy
stigmergy.info: Ants drop pheromone. Successful paths thicken; weak trails evaporate. Shortest route emerges with no map.

superorganism.title: Superorganism
superorganism.info: Zoom from agent to colony. Local rules at the leaf become one decision at the crown — many bodies, one mind.

swarm-intelligence.title: Swarm Intelligence
swarm-intelligence.info: Particles search a fitness landscape. Share personal and global bests; the swarm converges on the peak.

connectome.title: Connectome
connectome.info: Wiring diagram of a mind. Prune edges and functional clusters fracture; density tracks residual capacity.
